notes:
This dataset contains Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping products for activation EMSR917. On 11/08/2026 at 12:00, a wildfire was detected in Lurë National Park, Municipality of Dibër, Albania. The fire has affected pastureland and pine forest areas and spread under conditions of high fuel load and low humidity. Ground and aerial firefighting resources were deployed, while firebreaks were established to protect nearby villages at risk. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide wildfire extent and damage assessment mapping to support operational response and planning activities.

**Citation:** Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2026 European Union), EMSR917

**Product types present in this dataset's resources:**  
**DEL (Delineation)**: maps the extent of the event itself (eg. flood, fire, landslide boundary).  
**GRA (Grading)**: assesses damage to individual features (eg. buildings, infrastructure).

Where a GeoPackage download is available for an Area of Interest/round, it already contains every layer with its official Copernicus styling and colours - prefer it in GIS software over the zipped shapefile download.
